fullDesc: On March 24, 1989 the oil tanker Exxon Valdez ran aground in Prince William Sound, Alaska, spilling about 41 million litres of crude oil. It devastated wildlife and remains one of the largest spills.
realFacts: Hundreds of thousands of seabirds died
It cost Exxon billions in cleanup and fines
The Oil Pollution Act of 1990 followed
Some oil is still present in the sand
